# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #338 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Each check is self-contained and runnable from the worktree root. State-mutating sandboxes live under
`$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-338/` — `/tmp` is refused by the state guard. Every check first builds
`dist/` (skip that line when the gate has already built the tree).

#### Check 1 — the published example files through the real CLI (P1, P3, P4)

```bash
npm run build
REPO=$(pwd)
SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-338/example"
rm -rf "$SB" && mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks"
trap 'rm -rf "$SB"' EXIT
node - "$SB" <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { formatGateReportExample } = require('./dist/domain');
const ws = process.argv[2];
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ws, '.agyloop/tasks/938.json'), JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'QUALITY_GATE', mode: 'standard', issue: 938,
  baseBranch: 'main', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'IMPLEMENT', timestamp: now }, { stage: 'QUALITY_GATE', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
const block = formatGateReportExample('PASSED')
  .replaceAll('<id>', 'node')
  .replaceAll('<command>', 'npm test')
  .replaceAll('<check-id>', 'check-1')
  .replaceAll('<check label>', 'app boots')
  .replaceAll('<gate-id>', 'e2e')
  .replaceAll('<gate label>', 'e2e suite')
  .replaceAll('<why it did not run>', 'no fixtures')
  .replaceAll('(N passed)', '(3 passed)')
  .replaceAll('"testsPassed": 0', '"testsPassed": 3')
  .replaceAll('"durationMs": 0', '"durationMs": 69000');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ws, 'gate.txt'), block, 'utf8');
console.log(block);
NODE
cd "$SB" && node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 938 --report-file gate.txt
node -e '
const report = require(process.argv[1]);
if (report.smokeChecks.length !== 1 || report.smokeChecks[0].passed !== true) throw new Error("smokeChecks.passed did not survive filing");
if (!report.notRun[0] || report.notRun[0].reason !== "no fixtures") throw new Error("notRun.reason did not survive filing");
console.log("filed:", JSON.stringify(report.smokeChecks), JSON.stringify(report.notRun));
' "$SB/.agyloop/tasks/938.gate.json"
```

Expected: `✓ Gate evidence recorded: PASSED — node — PASSED (3 passed) — 1m 9s`, then
`filed: [{"id":"check-1","label":"app boots","passed":true}] [{"id":"e2e","label":"e2e suite","reason":"no fixtures"}]`.
Baseline (`ac23dca`) fails at the `smokeChecks.length !== 1` assertion: the example publishes no such entry.

#### Check 2 — two gate rounds: evidence, then none (S1, S2, S3)

```bash
npm run build
node - <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');
const { TransitionStageUseCase } = require('./dist/application');
const { FileStateRepository, FilePlanGenerator } = require('./dist/infrastructure');
const { GateResultReport, STAGE_QUALITY_GATE, STAGE_REVIEW, STAGE_IMPLEMENT, resolveGateRound } = require('./dist/domain');

const ISSUE = 938;
const ws = path.join(os.homedir(), '.cache', 'agyloop', `smoke-${ISSUE}`, 'two-rounds');
const cleanup = () => fs.rmSync(ws, { recursive: true, force: true });

(async () => {
  cleanup();
  const planDir = path.join(ws, 'artifacts', 'plans', `${ISSUE}-smoke`);
  fs.mkdirSync(planDir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, 'implementation_plan.md'), '# Plan\n\n- [ ] Step 1\n', 'utf8');
  const summaryPath = path.join(planDir, 'CodeLoop Summary.md');
  fs.copyFileSync('templates/summary-log.md', summaryPath);

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(ws, '.agyloop', 'tasks'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ws, '.agyloop', 'tasks', `${ISSUE}.json`), JSON.stringify({
    version: '1.0.0', currentStage: STAGE_QUALITY_GATE, mode: 'standard', issue: ISSUE,
    baseBranch: 'main', planDir: `artifacts/plans/${ISSUE}-smoke`, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
    history: [{ stage: STAGE_IMPLEMENT, timestamp: now }, { stage: STAGE_QUALITY_GATE, timestamp: now }],
    pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
  }, null, 2));

  const reports = new Map();
  const repo = {
    load: (issue) => reports.get(String(issue)) ?? null,
    save: (issue, report) => { reports.set(String(issue), report); return 'evidence.json'; },
    clear: (issue) => { reports.delete(String(issue)); }
  };
  const transition = (targetStage) => new TransitionStageUseCase(
    new FileStateRepository({ workspaceDir: ws, issue: ISSUE }),
    undefined, undefined, new FilePlanGenerator(), repo
  ).execute({ targetStage, issue: ISSUE, workspaceDir: ws, noWorktree: true });

  // Round 1: full evidence, certified exit to REVIEW.
  const round1 = resolveGateRound([{ stage: STAGE_IMPLEMENT }, { stage: STAGE_QUALITY_GATE }]);
  repo.save(ISSUE, GateResultReport.fromJSON({
    verdict: 'PASSED', buildSystem: 'node', buildStatus: 'PASSED',
    testsStatus: 'PASSED (3 passed)', testsPassed: 3, testsFailed: 0, durationMs: 69000,
    executedCommands: ['npm test'],
    smokeChecks: [{ id: 'check-1', label: 'app boots', passed: null }],
    smokeProtocol: 'PASSED',
    notRun: [{ id: 'e2e', reason: 'no fixtures' }],
    gateRound: round1
  }, round1));
  await transition(STAGE_REVIEW);

  const first = fs.readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf8');
  for (const line of [
    '- **Executed Commands:** `npm test`',
    '- **Smoke Checks:** check-1 ❔',
    '- **Smoke Protocol:** PASSED',
    '- **Not Run:** e2e (no fixtures)'
  ]) {
    if (!first.includes(line)) throw new Error(`round 1 is missing: ${line}\n${first}`);
  }
  if (first.indexOf('Smoke Checks') > first.indexOf('Smoke Protocol')) {
    throw new Error('the protocol verdict must follow the per-check marks');
  }

  // Round 2: walk back to the gate and exit with NO evidence.
  await transition(STAGE_IMPLEMENT);
  await transition(STAGE_QUALITY_GATE);
  await transition(STAGE_IMPLEMENT);

  const second = fs.readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf8');
  const stale = second.split('\n').filter((line) =>
    line.startsWith('- **Build System:**') ||
    line.startsWith('- **Executed Commands:**') ||
    line.startsWith('- **Smoke Checks:**') ||
    line.startsWith('- **Smoke Protocol:**') ||
    line.startsWith('- **Not Run:**'));
  if (stale.length > 0) throw new Error(`stale metrics survived a NOT RECORDED round: ${stale.join(' | ')}`);
  if (!second.includes('- **Build Status:** not recorded')) throw new Error('Build Status must be not recorded');
  if (!second.includes('- **Tests:** not recorded')) throw new Error('Tests must be not recorded');

  console.log('round 1 rendered the evidence; round 2 cleared the metrics block');
  cleanup();
})().catch((err) => { cleanup(); console.error('SMOKE FAILED:', err.message); process.exit(1); });
NODE
```

Baseline (`ac23dca`): fails on the missing `- **Smoke Protocol:** PASSED` line, and would fail the
stale-line filter as well.

#### Check 3 — the in-process gate row names its clock (S4)

```bash
npm run build
node - <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');
const { RunQualityGateUseCase } = require('./dist/application');
const { FilePlanGenerator } = require('./dist/infrastructure');
const { StateMachine, MODE_STANDARD } = require('./dist/domain');

const ISSUE = 938;
const ws = path.join(os.homedir(), '.cache', 'agyloop', `smoke-${ISSUE}`, 'in-process');
const cleanup = () => fs.rmSync(ws, { recursive: true, force: true });

(async () => {
  cleanup();
  const planDir = path.join(ws, 'artifacts', 'plans', `${ISSUE}-in-process`);
  fs.mkdirSync(planDir, { recursive: true });
  const summaryPath = path.join(planDir, 'CodeLoop Summary.md');
  fs.copyFileSync('templates/summary-log.md', summaryPath);
  const planPath = path.join(planDir, 'implementation_plan.md');
  fs.writeFileSync(planPath, '# Plan\n\n## 4. Quality Gate & Test Verification\n\n### Quality Gate Targets\n\n```bash\ntrue\n```\n', 'utf8');

  const sm = StateMachine.createInitial({ issue: ISSUE, mode: MODE_STANDARD });
  sm.transition('DISCOVERY'); sm.transition('PLAN'); sm.transition('APPROVAL'); sm.transition('IMPLEMENT');
  sm.setPlanDir(`artifacts/plans/${ISSUE}-in-process`);
  const snapshot = sm.toSnapshot();

  const stateRepo = {
    load: async () => snapshot, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {},
    getStateFilePath: () => '.agyloop/state.json'
  };
  const configRepo = {
    loadConfig: () => ({ models: { planner: 'pro', implementer: 'inherit', gate: 'flash_lite', reviewer: 'flash' }, options: { gateTimeoutSeconds: 300, autoApproveInYolo: true, enableMcpInPlanner: true } }),
    resolveModel: () => ({ configured: 'flash_lite', tier: 'flash_lite', apiModel: 'x' }),
    mapModelToTier: () => 'flash_lite'
  };
  const planGenerator = new FilePlanGenerator();
  planGenerator.resolvePlanFile = () => ({ planDir, planPath, planFileName: 'implementation_plan.md', summaryPath });
  planGenerator.readPlanDocument = () => fs.readFileSync(planPath, 'utf8');
  planGenerator.hashPlanDocument = () => 'stable-digest';
  const commandExecutor = {
    execute: async (command) => ({ command, exitCode: 0, stdout: '# tests 3\n# pass 3\n# fail 0', stderr: '', combinedOutput: '# tests 3\n# pass 3\n# fail 0', durationMs: 150, timedOut: false })
  };
  const resolveSubagent = { execute: () => ({ name: 'gate', model: 'flash_lite' }) };

  const useCase = new RunQualityGateUseCase(stateRepo, configRepo, planGenerator, commandExecutor, undefined, resolveSubagent, undefined);
  const result = await useCase.execute({ issue: ISSUE, workspaceDir: ws, commands: ['true'] });
  if (!result.passed) throw new Error('the probe gate must pass');

  const summary = fs.readFileSync(summaryPath, 'utf8');
  const row = summary.split('\n').find((line) => line.startsWith('| 4. Quality Gate |')) || '';
  const cell = (row.split('|')[5] || '').trim();
  if (!/\(gate-reported(?:; (?:\d+m )?\d+s wall)?\)$/.test(cell)) {
    throw new Error(`the in-process gate row must name its clock, got: "${cell}"`);
  }
  if (!summary.includes('- **Smoke Protocol:**')) {
    throw new Error('the in-process round must render the protocol verdict');
  }
  console.log('in-process row:', row);
  console.log('in-process metrics:', summary.split('## Quality Gate Metrics')[1].split('##')[0].trim());
  cleanup();
})().catch((err) => { cleanup(); console.error('SMOKE FAILED:', err.message); process.exit(1); });
NODE
```

Expected: the row cell ends with `(gate-reported; … wall)` (or `(gate-reported)` when the window is
unmeasurable), and the metrics block carries `- **Smoke Protocol:** PASSED|FAILED|NOT_DECLARED`.
Baseline (`ac23dca`): `row: | 4. Quality Gate | \`gate\` | \`flash_lite\` | COMPLETED | 0s |` — no label.

#### Check 4 — the no-protocol prompt still invents nothing (P1, P2, P5)

```bash
npm run build
node - <<'NODE'
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require('./dist/application');
const { GateResultReport, formatGateReportExample, NOTE_GATE_REPORT_EVIDENCE_SHAPES } = require('./dist/domain');

const noProtocol = formatGateReportExample('NOT_DECLARED');
if (!noProtocol.includes('"smokeChecks": []')) {
  throw new Error(`a no-protocol plan must be shown no check: ${noProtocol}`);
}
const report = GateResultReport.parseBlock(noProtocol, 1);
if (report.smokeChecks.length !== 0) throw new Error('a no-protocol example filed checks');
if (!NOTE_GATE_REPORT_EVIDENCE_SHAPES.includes('"passed": true') ||
    !NOTE_GATE_REPORT_EVIDENCE_SHAPES.includes('"reason"')) {
  throw new Error('the published shapes must name both entry shapes');
}
const prompt = new ResolveSubagentUseCase({ loadConfig: () => ({ models: {}, options: {} }) }).buildGateTaskPrompt({ issueNumber: 938 });
for (const token of ['"id": "<check-id>"', '"passed": true', '"reason": "<why it did not run>"', 'BOOLEAN or `null`', 'array of bare strings is rejected']) {
  if (!prompt.includes(token)) throw new Error(`the dispatched prompt is missing: ${token}`);
}
console.log('no-protocol example filed with zero checks; prompt publishes both shapes');
NODE
```
